meaning.zh:
“表现突出” 或 “状态极佳”。

“On a tear” 这个短语来源于运动或比赛中某人连胜或表现特别出色的情形。就如同 “tear”（撕裂）这个词的寓意，表示某人或球队在某一时间段内连续取得良好成绩，无人能挡。
meaning.en: This idiom derives from sports or competition contexts where someone experiences a winning streak or outstanding performance. Much like the word "tear," which can mean to rip through something, it conveys the idea of someone or a team performing exceptionally well over a period of time, almost unstoppable.

lines.en: The team has been *on a tear* lately, winning five games in a row.
lines.zh: 这支队伍最近表现突出，连赢了五场比赛。

lines.en: She's *on a tear* at work, securing three big clients this month alone.
lines.zh: 她在工作中表现突出，仅在本月就拿下了三个大客户。

lines.en: John has been *on a tear* playing poker, winning almost every hand.
lines.zh: 约翰在打扑克时状态极佳，几乎每一局都赢。
